messages:
Samir Patel: Heads-up — Prospect FinRegCo wants the POC to be EU-only for data residency. They asked for: full subprocessor list for Frankfurt, assurance that traffic won't egress to APAC/US, and confirmation KMS keys will reside in EU. Demo scheduled next Wed.

Mia Chen: Quick clarifying Q: do they require Private (VPC/on-prem) or is hosted reserved capacity acceptable for the POC?

Samir Patel: Hosted preferred for speed, but their compliance questionnaire says "no cross-border egress". They also want SSO, observability, and managed infra subprocessors listed explicitly.

Jordan Lee: We can tenant-pin requests to eu-central-1 on hosted. Notes: 1) failover behavior: we only failover to EU-region-compatible variants (no APAC/US fallback) if enabled; 2) our control plane currently defaults to us-west2 unless we spin up an EU control plane for the tenant — that affects metrics/telemetry residency.

Ana Gomez: For the security questionnaire we need the subproc manifest + the EU-data addendum language. Legal keeps an EU-only manifest for customers who sign the addendum. @Mia do we have the latest CSV export?

Mia Chen: I have the list but it needs legal sign-off. Example snippet I usually send to customers:

```text
- Compute: GCP (eu-central-1) via ManagedPoolX
- Storage: Redwood-managed S3-eu (encrypted at-rest)
- Observability: LogAggregatorEU (subprocessor)
- Auth: Okta (offers EU hosting option)
```

Evan Brooks: Ops/cost note: enabling tenant-pin + EU control plane for a short-lived POC is roughly +12% infra premium. BYOK in-region (customer KMS) requires a one-off enablement (~2 eng-days) for hosted + network configs. Also small monthly infra delta if we keep EU control plane running.

Samir Patel: They asked whether BYOK is mandatory for the demo. They'd prefer BYOK as soon as possible.

Jordan Lee: BYOK path: hosted can use envelope encryption where customer KMS (EU) holds the key if we enable EU control plane. Private requires KMS peering and additional network setup. Engineering estimates: ~2 infra days + 1 security review day for hosted BYOK enablement.

Ana Gomez: I'll kick off the security review and request legal to provide SCCs / transfer paperwork if needed. Also will pull the signed subproc manifest template and the EU addendum.

Mia Chen: Action items: 1) @Jordan confirm capacity SLA for pinned tenant in eu-central-1 for a 1-week POC; 2) @Evan finalize POC cost delta and one-off BYOK enablement estimate; 3) @Ana fetch the signed subproc manifest and EU addendum template. I'll draft a response to FinRegCo once we have these.

OpsBot: task created — deploy-request #472: tenant-pin-eu POC (owner: Jordan Lee).

Jordan Lee: I can validate capacity today and provision a pinned pool if approved. ETA to provision: ~48h once I have go-ahead.

Samir Patel: Great — please confirm BYOK estimate and subproc list by EOD so I can reply to the prospect. Thanks everyone.
